extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent illustrators, and patent attorneys preparing drawings for European Patent Office (EPO) filings
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing patent drawings (drawings, photographs, diagrams, flowsheets) that comply with European Patent Office (EPO) formal requirements to avoid objections and delays. Covers permitted media, paper/sheet specifications, view types, annotation/symbol rules, shading, and procedural items (e.g., petitions for color).

rubrics_metrics.name: General requirement to follow EPO drawing rules
rubrics_metrics.description: All patent drawings, photographs, diagrams, and flowsheets must follow EPO drawing rules; failure to comply can trigger examiner objections and increase patent grant time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow rules stringently to cut down office actions, save cost/time, and avoid first-hand rejection of the drawings and application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Black and white drawings required
rubrics_metrics.description: EPO requires drawings to be black and white.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use black printing ink (e.g., India ink) for paper drawings. When drawings are produced with software, generate them using only black color. Be aware that other colors printed in black-and-white may give different grey shades.

rubrics_metrics.name: Black and white photographs allowed only when necessary
rubrics_metrics.description: Photographs are permissible only when they are the only available medium to illustrate the invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include chemical structures, cell structures, or beauty products. Photographs must be high quality so details print clearly in black-and-white.

rubrics_metrics.name: Colored photographs acceptance conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Color photographs are acceptable only if the conditions for black-and-white photographs are satisfied and the color photograph also meets color-drawing conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure color photographs still satisfy the quality/detail printing requirements when converted to black-and-white.

rubrics_metrics.name: Colour drawings allowed only if unavoidable and by petition
rubrics_metrics.description: Colour drawings must be used only when there is no alternative medium to express the invention; they must be high quality and printable in black-and-white. Colour drawings are prohibited in international applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To include colour drawings you must file a petition with the EPO explaining their significance. The petition requirements: pay petition filing fee; submit a black-and-white photocopy of the colour drawing with similar details and 3 sets of color drawings; include the specific paragraph in the description that informs the Office/public about colour drawings and availability upon request and payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required paragraph for colour drawings petition
rubrics_metrics.description: When filing colour drawings under petition, include the specified paragraph in the drawing description.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The paragraph: “The patent or application file contains at least one drawing executed in color. Copies of this patent or patent application publication with color drawing(s) will be provided by the Office upon request and payment of the necessary fee”.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawing identification information
rubrics_metrics.description: Each drawing must include identification details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include title of the invention, name of the inventor, and application number/docket number. Place this information on the front page, aligned to the center at the top margin.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sheet size consistency and permitted dimensions
rubrics_metrics.description: All drawing sheets must be the same size and conform to EPO-allowed dimensions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Permitted dimensions: 21.0 × 29.7 cm or 21.6 × 27.9 cm. Paper weight should be 80–120 g/m² (gsm).

rubrics_metrics.name: Paper type and condition
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawing paper must be suitable for official filing and reproduction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use flexible, durable, white, non-shiny, smooth paper. Do not use sheets with folds or creases. Use only one side of the sheet. Avoid erasure marks, overwriting, and alterations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page margins for drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: All sheets must observe the EPO-specified margins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Top margin: 2.5 cm; Left margin: 2.5 cm; Right margin: 1.5 cm; Bottom margin: 1.0 cm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Orthogonal views requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Include all relevant orthogonal views of the invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide top, bottom, side, front, back views as appropriate to fully show the invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perspective views guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Include one or more perspective views to show the invention clearly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preferably keep one view per sheet; do not recommend more than two views per sheet for clarity. Avoid wasting sheets; maintain proper spacing between views. NOTE: Do not use the same sheets for both views and claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exploded views usage and placement
rubrics_metrics.description: Exploded views show the working order or relationship of assembled parts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place exploded views within brackets. Use exploded views when needed to show assembly relationships (see specialized guidance on exploded views).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sectional views requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Use sectional views to show hidden areas or internal parts by cutting away parts of the object.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate the cutting line (cutting plane) clearly. See additional guidance on sectional views for conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of scale
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawings should use a scale that shows the mechanism without crowding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not indicate 'actual size' or 'scale 1/2' on the drawings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawing surface shading conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Shading indicates surface conditions or shape of objects in drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer spaced, thin lines for shading, few in number, and contrasting with rest of drawing. Stippling is allowed (recommended for design patent drawings). Assume light source from upper-left at 45°. Pitch-black shading is prohibited (except allowed for bar graphs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference characters and lettering
rubrics_metrics.description: Use legible reference characters and lettering placed clearly relative to figures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the English alphabet for references; other alphabets may be used for specialized items (wavelengths, angles, formulas). Avoid brackets or inverted commas. Minimum character height: 0.32 cm. Place references on clear surfaces, avoid placing over figures or shaded areas. Orient references in the direction of the drawing view.

rubrics_metrics.name: Graphical symbols and symbol sizing
rubrics_metrics.description: Use graphical symbols for conventional elements that have worldwide acceptance in the art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Symbols' capital letters must have a height of 0.21 cm. Use symbols for elements with conventional meaning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of arrows in drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Arrows may be used at ends of lines to indicate sections or motion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use arrows at the tip of a lead line to indicate the entire section in the direction of the arrow and to indicate direction of movement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leadline conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Leadlines connect reference characters to the referenced details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep leadlines as short as possible. Leadlines may be straight or curved and must not overlap each other.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright / mask work notices
rubrics_metrics.description: Copyright or mask work notices may be placed on drawings with limitations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the notice just below the relevant figure. Letter height should be 0.32–0.64 cm. Limit notice contents as required by law and use authorized language to obtain any permit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing and miscellaneous tips
rubrics_metrics.description: Various procedural and formatting tips to aid compliance and processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit durable and permanent corrections to the Office. Avoid holes in the drawing sheets. Number different views and sheets with Arabic numerals. Place authorized security markings centered at the top margin of the page.
